description: Select Technologies Limited is a Pakistani technology-manufacturing company formed in 2021 as a wholly owned subsidiary of Air Link Communication Limited. It assembles consumer electronics and smart devices locally at its plant in Kot Lakhpat, Lahore — smartphones, televisions and home appliances — and is listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange.
headOffice: 152/1-M, Quaid-e-Azam Industrial Estate, Kot Lakhpat, Lahore, Pakistan
